set system host-name CSG.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols mpls interface all.explanation: Enables the MPLS protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols ldp interface ge-1/0/0.explanation: Enables the LDP protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols bgp group ibgp.explanation: This command configures a BGP group named [parameter1], defining a set of BGP peers with shared session parameters.

neighbor 2.2.2.2.explanation: Configure the neighbors of the BGP team.

set protocols bgp group ibgp neighbor 2..template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] bfd-liveness-detection minimum-interval [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group ibgp neighbor 2..command: set protocols bgp group ibgp neighbor 2.2.2.2 bfd-liveness-detection minimum-interval 300
set protocols bgp group ibgp neighbor 2..explanation: 配置BGP邻居的BFD检测最小间隔。

parameters.name: minimum-interval
parameters.explanation: BFD检测的最小间隔时间，单位为毫秒。

set protocols bgp group ibgp neighbor 2..template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] add-path
set protocols bgp group ibgp neighbor 2..command: set protocols bgp group ibgp neighbor 2.2.2.2 add-path

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0.explanation: This command configures an OSPF area in Junos OS, where `[parameter1]` specifies the area ID, enabling OSPF routing within the defined area.

network 10.1.1.0/24.explanation: Configure the assigned area network of the OSPF protocol.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 1.1.1.1/32.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.
